constraints.name: finance_tax_document_corrections_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'issued'::text])) = ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(approval_evidence), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: finance_tax_document_corrections_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'issued'::text) = ((issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: finance_tax_document_corrections_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'cancelled'::text) = ((cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(cancel_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))
